explanation: Continuous second partials require (f_x)_y=(f_y)_x throughout U. I gives 2y versus 4y, so it fails on any nonempty open set. II gives 1 on both sides and is realized by f=x²+xy+(2/3)y^(3/2) on y>0. III gives 2x+2y versus 2xy+2, which cannot agree throughout an open set. Thus II only is valid.
